articles.headline: Bihar MLA Anant Singh Hosts Grand Wedding Celebrations for Daughter Shivangi in Patna
articles.dek: Extravagant wedding preparations for Bihar MLA Anant Singh's daughter Shivangi in Ladma village feature a horse race with a Thar SUV prize, massive kitchens producing 50 lakh gulab jamuns, and viral haldi ceremony videos.

p: The ancestral village of Bihar MLA Anant Singh in Patna has transformed into a major hub of public attention as preparations for his daughter Shivangi's upcoming nuptials reach their peak. Widely referred to as Chhote Sarkar, the politician is sparing no expense to ensure the wedding becomes an unforgettable affair.

The wedding venue features elaborate arrangements designed to accommodate large crowds and high-profile attendees, turning the local rural landscape into a bustling epicenter of celebration and festive activity ahead of the main ceremony.

Shivangi is set to marry Rishikesh Kumar, the son of commandant Ranvijay Kumar, on November 25. The wedding ceremony will take place in Ladma village, drawing family, friends, and supporters from various regions to witness the union.
With the wedding date fast approaching, the household has already commenced multiple pre-wedding rituals and ceremonies, setting a lively tone for the multi-day festivities in the ancestral home.

body.h: High-Stakes Horse Race and Thar SUV Prize
p: One of the most talked-about attractions planned for the wedding festivities is a traditional horse race. Despite recent rainfall turning the ground muddy, workers have been actively leveling and preparing the track to ensure the competition goes ahead without a hitch.
According to close aide Kanhaiya Singh, the race is expected to feature a Mahindra Thar SUV as the top prize for the winner, accompanied by traditional recognition and respect from the hosts.

To facilitate the smooth arrival of guests and dignitaries, organizers have constructed a special helipad close to a nearby highway. Additionally, extensive tent networks have been erected across the venue grounds to shelter attendees.

Anant Singh's three sons—Ankit, Abhishek, and Abhinav—have been actively participating in the hosting duties, greeting arriving guests while dressed in bright yellow kurtas that match the festive mood.

body.h: Massive Kitchens and 50 Lakh Gulab Jamuns
p: Food arrangements have emerged as a monumental undertaking for the wedding, highlighted by a massive tent stretching over 100 feet that serves as a central cooking hub. Preparations are currently underway to produce more than 50 lakh gulab jamuns for the visiting masses.

Visual documentation from the venue reveals enormous steel containers filled with the popular sweet dish. Furthermore, milk supplies are being transported directly to the kitchens via large tankers weighing around 10,000 kg, alongside 12 additional cooking tents set up to handle the immense culinary demand.

body.h: Viral Haldi Ceremony and Musical Festivities
p: A special musical programme organized as part of Shivangi's haldi ceremony quickly caught the attention of social media users after clips surfaced online. Artists performed on stage while the MLA joined the performers, enthusiastically encouraging them during their acts.

The energetic presence of Anant Singh at the family event was widely captured on camera, generating significant traction across digital platforms and contributing to the viral status of the pre-wedding celebrations.

Bihar MLA Anant Singh is hosting grand wedding celebrations for his daughter Shivangi in Ladma village, featuring a high-profile horse race with a Thar SUV prize and massive catering arrangements including 50 lakh gulab jamuns. Videos from the family's haldi ceremony have also gone viral online ahead of the November 25 wedding.

facts: Bihar MLA Anant Singh's daughter Shivangi is marrying Rishikesh Kumar on November 25 in Ladma village.
Rishikesh Kumar is the son of commandant Ranvijay Kumar.
A horse race with a Thar SUV as the top prize is planned for the wedding.
Over 50 lakh gulab jamuns are being prepared in a massive kitchen using milk transported in 10,000 kg tankers.
Anant Singh's three sons are named Ankit, Abhishek, and Abhinav.
keywords: Anant Singh Thar prize horse race

articles.headline: Avinash Mishra Apologizes Following Split From Eisha Singh Amid Viral Video Controversy
articles.dek: Television stars Avinash Mishra and Eisha Singh have parted ways, sparking intense online drama, accusations of infidelity, leaked chats, and a public apology from Avinash over a controversial DJ gig video.

body.h: The Split Of Avinash Mishra And Eisha Singh
p: The romantic relationship between television personalities Avinash Mishra and Eisha Singh has come to an end, creating significant waves across social media platforms. The couple had been dating for a while before deciding to part ways, leaving their dedicated fanbase, often referred to as AvIsha fans, deeply heartbroken by the sudden development.

Following the announcement of their breakup, the situation quickly escalated into a public debate. Fandoms on both sides began expressing strong opinions, targeting the individuals involved and their close circles as speculation regarding the reasons behind the split mounted across the internet.

body.h: Cheating Allegations And Leaked Chat Controversy
p: The breakup took a contentious turn when reports surfaced accusing Avinash of being unfaithful to Eisha. These cheating allegations fueled intense backlash from respective fandoms and drew comments from public figures within the television industry.

Adding fuel to the fire, Eisha's brother Rudraksh, alongside Rajat Dalal, publicly criticized Avinash. In the midst of the online friction, Rudraksh went a step further by leaking a private chat involving the Khatron Ke Khiladi 15 winner, in which Avinash reportedly admitted to cheating on the actress.

Tensions heightened further when Avinash made headlines for a video captured during a DJ gig. In the viral clip, the actor was seen enjoying and grooving to the song 'Bewafa Nikali Hai Tu', which many observers interpreted as a direct and fresh jibe directed at Eisha.

The video circulated rapidly across social media platforms, drawing sharp criticism from Eisha's supporters and loved ones who viewed the song choice as an intentional provocation following their high-profile separation.
As the controversy surrounding the viral video and leaked chats intensified, Eisha broke her silence on the matter. Expressing her frustration, she warned against pushing her past her limits.

The actress stated that she wanted to avoid being forced into releasing every single proof with proper names regardless of the consequences. Reflecting on the heartbreak, she admitted to making the mistake of trusting someone who eventually stabbed her in the back and noted her intention to try moving on since it appeared to come so easily to others.

body.h: Avinash Mishra Issues A Public Apology
p: Following widespread backlash over the DJ gig clip, Avinash took to his Instagram story to address the chaos. He clarified that playing the song at his gig had led to numerous meanings and edits being circulated online, acknowledging that the incident deeply hurt Eisha, her family, and her loved ones.

The actor maintained that he had no such intention while playing the track, but explicitly stated that he was sorry for everything that had occurred. He also shouldered the blame for the relationship ending, accepting full responsibility for the breakup.

body.h: Plea To Protect Friends And Family
p: Amid the ongoing social media turmoil, Avinash issued a special request to fans and followers to halt the escalation. He urged everyone to bring an end to the matter and stop dragging family and friends into the dispute.

He highlighted that the issue strictly concerned two people and pleaded with supporters to stop sending inappropriate messages and threats to loved ones who had nothing to do with the personal fallout.

Concluding his address to the public, Avinash dropped strong hints about taking a temporary break from social media to focus on his personal well-being. He emphasized the necessity of working on himself and attempting to fix things internally.
The actor stated that he would only return once he felt okay, while wishing well for everyone and reiterating his call to put a definitive end to the public feud.

Television actors Avinash Mishra and Eisha Singh have ended their relationship, leading to intense online scrutiny and cheating allegations backed by leaked chats from Eisha's brother. Following backlash over a viral video of Avinash dancing to a provocative song during a DJ gig, Avinash issued a public apology, took full blame for the split, and announced plans to take a break from social media.

facts: Avinash Mishra and Eisha Singh broke up after dating for a while.
Avinash Mishra was seen dancing to 'Bewafa Nikali Hai Tu' during a DJ gig.
Eisha's brother Rudraksh and Rajat Dalal called out Avinash over the viral video.
Rudraksh leaked a chat where the Khatron Ke Khiladi 15 winner admitted to cheating.
Avinash Mishra posted an apology video on his Instagram story on November 23, 2026.
keywords: Avinash Mishra Eisha Singh break up
